My dear [Mrs Wordsworth](/person/1569)
I hope to come down to Salisbury by 2.24 on Tuesday, but as I owe an afternoon to the Moberlys, I will send on my goods and my maid to the Palace, and appear there myself at about 5 o’clock[^2]

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge


[^1]: Dating from after the death of George Moberly in July 1885, and probably dating from before the death of his widow Mary Ann Moberly in February 1890.
[^2]: Susan Esther (Coxe) Wordsworth (d. 1894) was the first wife of the Right Rev.

John Wordsworth (1843-1911), who succeeded George Moberly as Bishop of Salisbury in 1885.
